scope: Substantive refresh of a 602 word post at its existing URL

observations.summary: Removed the unsourced 'leach field can last up to 25 years or more' claim and a link labeled septic leach field repair that pointed to /service-areas.

Tank separates sludge and scum; T-shaped outlet; effluent to perforated pipes or chambers in unsaturated soil; soil accepts, treats and disperses; overloaded drainfield can flood, surfacing sewage or causing backups; alternative systems use pumps or media.

Do not park or drive on the drainfield; plant trees an appropriate distance; keep roof drains, sump pumps and rainwater away; leaky toilet up to 200 gallons per day; spread laundry; inspect at least every three years, alternative systems about yearly.

Repair: replacement of a permitted, correctly sized OWTS; repair standards apply if structures do not exceed permit, one time allowance under 500 sq ft with no added bedrooms; upgrade standards for more bedrooms, 500+ sq ft or more structures; unpermitted parcels meet new development standards; technical report for slopes over 30 percent; EH Files online lookup.
observations.inference_limit: County program summary; homeowners confirm specifics with EH.

observations.summary: Softener brine can damage tank bacteria, clog the leach field and increase hydraulic load; separate drywell preferred.
Hours, free quotes and flat-rate pricing restated; leach field repair and replacement is an existing service.
observations.inference_limit: Only confirmed business facts are restated.
